summary: Terraform Enterprise / HCP Terraform handle infrastructure-as-code provisioning while AAP handles configuration, deployment and orchestration. Combined they aim to optimize costs, reduce risk (review plan output with approval steps) and speed time to value across Day 0, Day 1 and Day 2 operations.
